Simulation without assumptions about mutation rate, recombination rate, or population size

```{r}

# Load necessary library
library(Biostrings)

# Set parameters for simulation
total_length <- 100000  # 100 kb region
num_individuals <- 100  # Population size
num_generations <- 50  # Number of generations
alleles <- c("A", "T", "C", "G")  # Map A1, A2, B1, B2 to nucleotides
gene_length <- total_length / 2  # Split between Gene A and Gene B

# Function to initialize random alleles for genes A and B, with more realistic sequence
initialize_population <- function(n, gene_length) {
  population <- data.frame(
    Gene_A = sample(alleles[1:2], n, replace = TRUE),  # A1, A2 -> A, T
    Gene_B = sample(alleles[3:4], n, replace = TRUE)   # B1, B2 -> C, G
  )
  
  # Create more realistic random sequences
  population$Seq_A <- sapply(population$Gene_A, function(allele) {
    # For A1 (A), A2 (T), generate random sequence for the gene
    if (allele == "A") {
      return(paste(sample(c("A", "T", "C", "G"), gene_length, replace = TRUE), collapse = ""))
    } else {
      return(paste(sample(c("A", "T", "C", "G"), gene_length, replace = TRUE), collapse = ""))
    }
  })
  
  population$Seq_B <- sapply(population$Gene_B, function(allele) {
    # For B1 (C), B2 (G), generate random sequence for the gene
    if (allele == "C") {
      return(paste(sample(c("A", "T", "C", "G"), gene_length, replace = TRUE), collapse = ""))
    } else {
      return(paste(sample(c("A", "T", "C", "G"), gene_length, replace = TRUE), collapse = ""))
    }
  })
  
  return(population)
}

# Function to simulate selection on the population
apply_selection <- function(population, selection_type) {
  if (selection_type == "plastic") {
    # Favor the plastic allele (e.g., A1B1) -> A and C
    selected <- population$Gene_A == "A" & population$Gene_B == "C"
  } else if (selection_type == "canalized") {
    # Favor canalized haplotype (A1B1 or A2B2)
    selected <- (population$Gene_A == "A" & population$Gene_B == "C") | 
                (population$Gene_A == "T" & population$Gene_B == "G")
  }
  # Apply selection by keeping selected individuals
  return(population[selected, , drop = FALSE])
}

# Function to simulate recombination between alleles A and B
recombine <- function(population) {
  new_pop <- population
  recombination_indices <- sample(1:nrow(population), nrow(population) / 2)
  
  for (i in recombination_indices) {
    # Randomly swap B allele between two individuals to simulate recombination
    new_pop[i, "Seq_B"] <- population[sample(1:nrow(population), 1), "Seq_B"]
  }
  return(new_pop)
}

# Function to generate DNA sequences
generate_dna_sequences <- function(population, gene_length) {
  sequences <- character(nrow(population))
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(population)) {
    # Combine both gene sequences (A and B) into a full sequence
    sequences[i] <- paste(population$Seq_A[i], population$Seq_B[i], sep = "")
  }
  return(sequences)
}

# Main simulation loop
population <- initialize_population(num_individuals, gene_length)

# Simulate over generations
for (generation in 1:num_generations) {
  # Apply selection for the plastic phenotype (A1B1 -> A and C)
  population <- apply_selection(population, "plastic")
  
  # Recombination step
  population <- recombine(population)
  
  # Apply selection for the canalized phenotype (A1B1 or A2B2 -> A and C or T and G)
  population <- apply_selection(population, "canalized")
}

# Generate the final DNA sequences
final_sequences <- generate_dna_sequences(population, gene_length)

# Create a names vector for the sequences
seq_names <- paste("Individual", 1:length(final_sequences), sep = "_")

# Convert sequences into a Biostrings object to output FASTA format
fasta_sequences <- DNAStringSet(final_sequences)
names(fasta_sequences) <- seq_names

# Write the FASTA file
writeXStringSet(fasta_sequences, "arg_sim/simulated_population.fasta")

# Print the first few sequences to check
head(fasta_sequences)

```

Model different mutation rates, recombination rates, and pop sizes

```{r}

# Set parameters for simulation
total_length <- 100000  # 100 kb region
num_generations <- 50  # Number of generations
alleles <- c("A", "T", "C", "G")  # Map A1, A2, B1, B2 to nucleotides
gene_length <- total_length / 2  # Split between Gene A and Gene B

# Function to initialize random alleles for genes A and B, with more realistic sequence
initialize_population <- function(n, gene_length) {
  population <- data.frame(
    Gene_A = sample(alleles[1:2], n, replace = TRUE),  # A1, A2 -> A, T
    Gene_B = sample(alleles[3:4], n, replace = TRUE)   # B1, B2 -> C, G
  )
  
  # Create more realistic random sequences
  population$Seq_A <- sapply(population$Gene_A, function(allele) {
    paste(sample(c("A", "T", "C", "G"), gene_length, replace = TRUE), collapse = "")
  })
  
  population$Seq_B <- sapply(population$Gene_B, function(allele) {
    paste(sample(c("A", "T", "C", "G"), gene_length, replace = TRUE), collapse = "")
  })
  
  return(population)
}

# Function to apply selection on the population
apply_selection <- function(population, selection_type) {
  if (selection_type == "plastic") {
    selected <- population$Gene_A == "A" & population$Gene_B == "C"
  } else if (selection_type == "canalized") {
    selected <- (population$Gene_A == "A" & population$Gene_B == "C") | 
                (population$Gene_A == "T" & population$Gene_B == "G")
  }
  return(population[selected, , drop = FALSE])
}

# Function to simulate recombination between alleles A and B
recombine <- function(population, recombination_rate) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(population) * recombination_rate)) {
    ind1 <- sample(1:nrow(population), 1)
    ind2 <- sample(1:nrow(population), 1)
    # Swap Gene_B sequences to simulate recombination
    temp <- population[ind1, "Seq_B"]
    population[ind1, "Seq_B"] <- population[ind2, "Seq_B"]
    population[ind2, "Seq_B"] <- temp
  }
  return(population)
}

# Function to simulate mutations in the population
mutate <- function(population, mutation_rate) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(population))) {
    # Apply mutations to Gene_A
    if (runif(1) < mutation_rate) {
      pos <- sample(1:nchar(population$Seq_A[i]), 1)
      new_base <- sample(setdiff(alleles, substr(population$Seq_A[i], pos, pos)), 1)
      substr(population$Seq_A[i], pos, pos) <- new_base
    }
    # Apply mutations to Gene_B
    if (runif(1) < mutation_rate) {
      pos <- sample(1:nchar(population$Seq_B[i]), 1)
      new_base <- sample(setdiff(alleles, substr(population$Seq_B[i], pos, pos)), 1)
      substr(population$Seq_B[i], pos, pos) <- new_base
    }
  }
  return(population)
}

# Function to generate DNA sequences
generate_dna_sequences <- function(population) {
  sequences <- character(nrow(population))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(population))) {
    sequences[i] <- paste(population$Seq_A[i], population$Seq_B[i], sep = "")
  }
  return(sequences)
}

# Main simulation loop with different scenarios
recombination_rates <- c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1)  # Recombination rates
mutation_rates <- c(1e-6, 1e-5, 1e-4)      # Mutation rates
population_sizes <- c(50, 100, 200)        # Effective population sizes

# Iterate over all combinations of parameters
for (recomb_rate in recombination_rates) {
  for (mut_rate in mutation_rates) {
    for (pop_size in population_sizes) {
      # Initialize population
      population <- initialize_population(pop_size, gene_length)
      
      # Simulate over generations
      for (generation in seq_len(num_generations)) {
        # Apply selection for the plastic phenotype (A1B1 -> A and C)
        population <- apply_selection(population, "plastic")
        
        # Recombination step
        population <- recombine(population, recomb_rate)
        
        # Mutation step
        population <- mutate(population, mut_rate)
        
        # Apply selection for the canalized phenotype (A1B1 or A2B2)
        population <- apply_selection(population, "canalized")
        
        # Adjust population size dynamically to simulate effective population size
        if (nrow(population) > pop_size) {
          population <- population[sample(1:nrow(population), pop_size), ]
        }
      }
      
      # Generate the final DNA sequences
      final_sequences <- generate_dna_sequences(population)
      
      # Create a names vector for the sequences
      seq_names <- paste("Individual", seq_len(length(final_sequences)), sep = "_")
      
      # Convert sequences into a Biostrings object to output FASTA format
      fasta_sequences <- DNAStringSet(final_sequences)
      names(fasta_sequences) <- seq_names
      
      # Generate file name based on parameters
      file_name <- sprintf(
        "arg_sim/simulated_pop_recomb%.2f_mut%.1e_pop%d.fasta",
        recomb_rate, mut_rate, pop_size
      )
      
      # Write the FASTA file
      writeXStringSet(fasta_sequences, file_name)
      
      cat("Written:", file_name, "\n")
    }
  }
}

```
